outputs.explanation: Panel a shows a schematic icon plus example micrographs illustrating cropping/rotation/resizing; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic outlines plus example micrographs illustrating image spacing; not a data plot.
Panel c shows a schematic plus example micrographs illustrating insets/zoom; not a data plot.
Panel d shows a brightness/contrast slider schematic plus example micrographs; not a quantitative plot.
Panel e shows schematic color/contrast circles plus example micrographs for channel annotation; not a data plot.
Panel f shows schematic overlap diagrams plus example micrographs illustrating grayscale channels; not a data plot.
Panel g shows example micrographs with intensity calibration scales; the color scale is a legend, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
